def test_get_row():
    # Empty list
    assert get_row([], 1) == []

    # Single element match
    assert get_row([[1]], 1) == [(0, 0)]

    # Multiple occurrences in same row: columns come in descending order
    assert get_row([[1, 2, 1, 3, 1]], 1) == [(0, 4), (0, 2), (0, 0)]

    # Classic case: rows ascending, columns descending within each row
    lst = [[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], [1, 2, 3, 4, 1, 6], [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 1]]
    assert get_row(lst, 1) == [(0, 0), (1, 4), (1, 0), (2, 5), (2, 0)]

    # Element not present
    assert get_row([[1, 2], [3, 4]], 5) == []

    # Ragged rows (different lengths)
    assert get_row([[1, 2], [2, 3, 2]], 2) == [(0, 1), (1, 2), (1, 0)]

    # Element in every row
    assert get_row([[9, 9], [9]], 9) == [(0, 1), (0, 0), (1, 0)]

    # Empty rows mixed in
    assert get_row([[], [1], []], 1) == [(1, 0)]

    # No match in a single row
    assert get_row([[1, 2, 3]], 10) == []

    print("All tests passed!")

import pytest


def test_get_row():
    # Coordinates sorted by row ascending, column descending within each row
    assert get_row(
        [[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6],
         [4, 4, 5, 1, 2, 9],
         [6, 4, 1, 4, 2, 2]],
        4
    ) == [(0, 3), (1, 1), (1, 0), (2, 3), (2, 1)]

    # Empty outer list -> no coordinates
    assert get_row([], 1) == []

    # Inner empty lists handled gracefully
    assert get_row([[], [1], []], 1) == [(1, 0)]

    # Value not present anywhere -> empty result
    assert get_row([[1, 2], [3, 4]], 5) == []

    # Single occurrence
    assert get_row([[10, 20, 30]], 30) == [(0, 2)]

    # Duplicates in the same row come out in descending column order
    assert get_row([[7, 7, 7]], 7) == [(0, 2), (0, 1), (0, 0)]

    # Ragged rows of differing lengths
    assert get_row([[1], [1, 2], [], [2, 1]], 1) == [(0, 0), (1, 0), (3, 1)]

    # Multiple matches across rows preserve row-major ordering
    assert get_row([[5, 5], [5], [5, 5, 5]], 5) == [
        (0, 1), (0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 2), (2, 1), (2, 0)
    ]

    # Rows with no match are skipped
    assert get_row([[1, 2], [3, 9], [2, 2]], 2) == [(0, 1), (2, 1), (2, 0)]
